model_annotation: The plot illustrates the coverage achieved by four different language model configurations as a function of the number of completions (k), which is displayed on the x-axis on a logarithmic scale ranging from 2⁰ to 2⁸ (i.e., 1 to 256). The x-axis tick labels are spaced at powers of two, and the axis is labeled "Number of completions (k)". The y-axis, labeled "Coverage", is on a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. Four lines are plotted: a solid blue line with circular markers representing "Llama-3B", a solid green line with triangular markers for "Llama-3B + FT", a dashed light blue line with circular markers for "Llama-1B", and a dashed light green line with triangular markers for "Llama-1B + FT". All four lines show an increasing trend in coverage as k increases. The "Llama-3B" line starts at approximately 0.42 coverage at k=1 and rises to about 0.92 at k=256. The "Llama-3B + FT" line begins at around 0.40 and reaches approximately 0.90 at k=256. The "Llama-1B" line starts at about 0.05 and increases to roughly 0.80. The "Llama-1B + FT" line begins at approximately 0.05 and rises to about 0.82 at k=256. The "Llama-3B" and "Llama-3B + FT" lines are consistently above the "Llama-1B" and "Llama-1B + FT" lines across all values of k.
